name: Issued Licenses
description:
This dataset records issued business licenses, with each row representing a single license tied to a business. It includes 31 columns covering license identifiers, business names and trade names, business category, license type and status, creation and expiration dates, and contact phone numbers. Location details are extensive, including street address, city, state, ZIP code, borough, community board, council district, and geographic identifiers such as BIN, BBL, NTA, census tract, latitude, and longitude. Some fields, such as trade name, unit and suite, and several location attributes, are missing for a large share of rows.

The data could support analyses of licensing activity by business category, location, and status; mapping of licensed businesses across neighborhoods and districts; tracking of license creation and renewal timelines; and studies of geographic concentration or gaps in licensing. It may also be useful for address verification, contact outreach, or building dashboards that monitor active and expiring licenses.
